  "description": "- Design end-to-end architecture for business applications with Enterprise Architects, covering Application, Data, Analytics, and Infrastructure layers.\n- Integrate BI capabilities such as dashboards, reporting, SQL-based models, and data visualization into business applications.\n- Evaluate and recommend technology platforms, shared services, and solutions based on functional, performance, cost, and scalability needs.\n- Define and oversee Power BI dashboards, KPI reporting, and analytics frameworks for business users.\n- Stay updated with emerging trends in business applications, cloud, data analytics, and BI tools.\n- Collaborate with stakeholders to manage change management, solution adoption, and architectural governance.\n- Resolve complex architectural and data challenges using analytical thinking and structured problem-solving.",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\nTrên 5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Đại Học trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\n- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (preferred).\n- Minimum 10 years of experience in IT system deployment and integration, with at least 5 years in the financial or banking sector.\n- At least 5 years as a BI Architecture Lead in business applications or enterprise systems.\n- Successful go-live leadership of at least one major business application or enterprise IT system in a financial institution or bank.\n- Expert in reporting tools – Power BI (must have), Looker (good to have), Jasper (preferred)\n- Experience with Power BI Desktop, DAX, Power Query (M), and relational data modeling.\n- Expertise in JasperReports/JasperServer, including templates, datasets, and parameters.\n- Strong skills in SQL, data modeling, analytics integration, dashboards, reporting, and data visualization.\n- Knowledge of statistical analysis and ability to translate data insights using data storytelling.\n- Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nIT - Phần mềm"
